```{r}
df <- read_csv("data/METABRIC_RNA_Mutation.csv")
```

Extract clinical and expression columns

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Split the column names into the 3 types (same logic as your Python code)
clinical_cols <- names(df)[1:31]

mutation_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "_mut$")]

expression_cols <- setdiff(names(df)[32:ncol(df)], mutation_cols)

# Select clinical + gene expression only (drops the mutation columns)
df_ce <- df |>
  select(all_of(c(clinical_cols, expression_cols)))

paste("clinical variables:", length(clinical_cols))
paste("gene expression variables:", length(expression_cols))
```

```{r}
df |>

  skim()
```

 
## Biological pathway selection

4 biological pathways:

  - Estrogen / hormone signaling
  
  - PI3K–AKT–mTOR signaling
  
  - Cell cycle / proliferation
  
  - DNA repair

```{r}
#| code-fold: show

hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")

pathway_map <- tribble(
  ~gs_name,                           ~pathway,
  "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY", "Estrogen / hormone signaling",
  "HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE",  "Estrogen / hormone signaling",
  "HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING", "PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling",
  "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS",             "Cell cycle / proliferation",
  "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT",          "Cell cycle / proliferation",
  "HALLMARK_DNA_REPAIR",              "DNA repair"
)
```

Summary how many genes per pathway are available

```{r}
pathway_genes <- hallmark |>
  inner_join(pathway_map, by = "gs_name") |>
  distinct(pathway, gene_symbol) |>
  mutate(gene_lower = tolower(gene_symbol))   # your columns are lowercase (e.g. brca1)


# Use the FULL data frame, not the one trimmed with select(1:31)
data_genes <- tolower(names(df))

pathway_genes <- pathway_genes |>
  mutate(in_data = gene_lower %in% data_genes)

# Summary: how many genes per pathway are available
pathway_genes |>
  group_by(pathway) |>
  summarise(
    total_genes = n(),
    genes_available   = sum(in_data),
    percentage         = round(100 * genes_available / total_genes, 1)
  )
```

I selected Estrogen / hormone signaling, PI3K–AKT–mTOR signaling, Cell cycle / proliferation because they have many available genes

```{r}
pathway_genes |>
  filter(in_data) |>
  group_by(pathway) |>
  summarise(genes = paste(gene_symbol, collapse = ", "))
```

## Pathway scoring

Standardize expression of each genes and calculate pathway score as below:

$$
S_{i,p} = \frac{1}{|G_p|} \sum_{g \in G_p} Z_{ig}
$$

where:

- $i$: patient
- $p$: pathway
- $G_p$: genes belonging to pathway $p$ and present in METABRIC
- $Z_{ig}$: standardized expression of gene $g$ in patient $i$

```{r}
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 6

# 1. Map each available gene to its actual column name in the data
col_lookup <- tibble(col = names(df), gene_lower = tolower(names(df)))

pathway_cols <- pathway_genes |>
  filter(in_data) |>
  inner_join(col_lookup, by = "gene_lower")   # adds the `col` column

# 2. Z-score each gene column (mean 0, SD 1 across patients)
gene_cols <- unique(pathway_cols$col)

z_mat <- df |>
  select(all_of(gene_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))

# 3. Pathway score = mean z-score of the genes in G_p, per patient
pathway_scores <- pathway_cols |>
  split(~pathway) |>
  map(\(x) rowMeans(z_mat[, x$col, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(
    score_hormone    = `Estrogen / hormone signaling`,
    score_pi3k_akt   = `PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling`,
    score_cell_cycle = `Cell cycle / proliferation`,
    score_dna_repair = `DNA repair`
  )

df_full <- bind_cols(df, pathway_scores) |> 
  select(-c(score_dna_repair))

df_full |>
  select(patient_id, starts_with("score_")) |> 
  head()
```

## Clustering algorithm

I used k-mean clustering algorithm to cluster 2 subgroups based on 3 pathway score

```{r}
# 1. Prepare the score matrix (complete cases only, rescaled so all 4 scores have equal weight)
score_df <- df_full |>
  mutate(patient_row = row_number()) |>
  select(patient_row, starts_with("score_")) |>
  drop_na()

score_mat <- score_df |>
  select(starts_with("score_")) |>
  scale()

# 2. Run k-means for k = 2 and k = 3
set.seed(123)
km2 <- kmeans(score_mat, centers = 2, nstart = 50)

# 3. Attach cluster labels back to the data
score_df <- score_df |>
  mutate(cluster_k2 = factor(km2$cluster))

df_clust <- df_full |>
  mutate(patient_row = row_number()) |>
  left_join(score_df |> select(patient_row, cluster_k2), by = "patient_row")

# Visual profile
df_clust |>
  filter(!is.na(cluster_k2)) |>
  select(cluster_k2, starts_with("score_")) |>
  pivot_longer(-cluster_k2, names_to = "pathway", values_to = "score") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster_k2, y = score, fill = cluster_k2)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~pathway) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


::: {.callout-note}
We clustered 2 groups:

  - Group 1: Lower cell cycle, higher hormone signaling, lower PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling pathway score
  
  - Group 2: Higher cell cycle, lower hormone signaling, higher PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling pathway score

:::

## KM-curve

```{r}
df_clust %<>%
  mutate(surv = case_when(death_from_cancer == "Living" ~ 0, .default = 1))

survfit2(Surv(overall_survival_months, surv) ~ cluster_k2, data = df_clust) |>
  ggsurvfit() +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  labs(x = "Time (months)", y = "Overall survival probability",
       color = "Cluster", fill = "Cluster") +
  scale_ggsurvfit() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Exploratory analysis

## Clinical characteristic

```{r}
df_clust %<>%
  mutate(npi_cat = cut(
    nottingham_prognostic_index,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 2.4, 3.4, 4.4, 5.4, 6.4, Inf),
    labels = c("Excellent", "Good", "Moderate 1", "Moderate 2", "Poor", "Very poor"),
    right = TRUE
  )) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = cluster_k2,
    include = c(
      age_at_diagnosis,
      er_status,
      her2_status,
      pr_status,
      chemotherapy,
      hormone_therapy,
      radio_therapy,
      npi_cat
    ),
    label = list(
      age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age at diagnosis (years)",
      er_status        ~ "ER status",
      her2_status      ~ "HER2 status",
      pr_status        ~ "PR status",
      chemotherapy     ~ "Chemotherapy",
      hormone_therapy  ~ "Hormone therapy",
      radio_therapy    ~ "Radiotherapy",
      npi_cat          ~ "Nottingham Prognostic Index group"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      age_at_diagnosis ~ "{mean} ({sd})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      age_at_diagnosis ~ 1
    )
  )
```
## Age at diagnosis

```{r}
df_clust |>
  filter(!is.na(cluster_k2)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age_at_diagnosis, fill = cluster_k2, color = cluster_k2)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "Age at diagnosis (years)", y = "Density", fill = "Cluster", color = "Cluster") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Binary variables

```{r}
df_clust |>
  filter(!is.na(cluster_k2)) |>
  select(cluster_k2, er_status, her2_status, pr_status,
         chemotherapy, hormone_therapy, radio_therapy) |>
  mutate(across(
    c(chemotherapy, hormone_therapy, radio_therapy),
    ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )) |>
  mutate(across(-cluster_k2, as.character)) |>
  pivot_longer(-cluster_k2, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  count(cluster_k2, variable, value) |>
  group_by(cluster_k2, variable) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(value %in% c("Yes", "Positive")) |>      # keep only the "yes/positive" category
  mutate(variable = recode(variable,
    er_status       = "ER positive",
    her2_status     = "HER2 positive",
    pr_status       = "PR positive",
    chemotherapy    = "Chemotherapy",
    hormone_therapy = "Hormone therapy",
    radio_therapy   = "Radiotherapy"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster_k2, y = pct, fill = cluster_k2)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 1)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Percentage within cluster") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Nottingham prognostic index



```{r}
df_clust |>
  filter(!is.na(cluster_k2), !is.na(npi_cat)) |>
  count(cluster_k2, npi_cat) |>
  group_by(cluster_k2) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = npi_cat, y = pct, fill = cluster_k2)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 1)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.3, size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "NPI group", y = "Percentage within cluster", fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```
